description: While the Ukrainian military has (rightly) drawn a lot of attention for its innovations and adaptations, the Russian force has been changing too. While parts of the force have been battered, in some areas its capabilities have evolved well beyond where they were in 2022. And so today, in a discussion with Michael Kofman, I want to look at how the Russian military has changed since 2022, and where its strengths and weaknesses are today.
